about.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience across the full development cycle — from requirements gathering and architecture to production delivery — on small, medium and large-scale projects. A solid track record of technical growth (Developer → Senior → Tech Lead) at companies such as Accenture, MV, Compass.UOL and Fundação CERTI, working as a Fullstack engineer (React, Angular, Node.js, Python/FastAPI, Java) with a focus on microservices architecture, event-driven systems (EDA) and cloud integration (Azure, AWS). Experience leading multidisciplinary squads under agile methodologies, with hands-on DevOps practice (CI/CD, containers, messaging) and an active interest in AI Engineering applied to real products.

certi.bullet1: Worked as developer and tech lead on a Digital Twin project, building RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI) and a React frontend, on an event-driven architecture (EDA) with RabbitMQ messaging.
certi.bullet2: Led container deployment on internal servers (Portainer) and on client environments, covering development and testing cycles.
certi.bullet3: Developed a solution for an energy-sector innovation project using Python and AngularJS, following agile methodology with multidisciplinary teams.
certi.bullet4: Worked with the Oracle, PostgreSQL, Databricks and Redis data stack to support delivered solutions.

compass.bullet1: Acted as Tech Lead in Node.js and React on the UOL group's EdTech project, coordinating the team's technical deliveries for 5 months.
compass.bullet2: Developed the RaiaDrogasil e-commerce BFF in Node.js, NestJS and GraphQL, consuming the Magento2 core and microservices with MongoDB, Docker, RabbitMQ and Redis cache.
compass.bullet3: Worked on an internal project for client RD using Node.js and AWS Lambda (serverless architecture).
compass.bullet4: Conducted technical interviews and code-challenge reviews in Java Spring Boot and Node.js, contributing to the hiring process for new developers.

mv.bullet1: Maintained and evolved international business systems (hospital/healthcare ERP), with reports and screens in Java, Flex, HTML5, SCSS, TypeScript, Node.js, JPA and Hibernate.
mv.bullet2: Took part in the Flex-to-HTML5 stack migration, including building a RESTful API in Node.js to convert XML documents to JSON.
mv.bullet3: Joined the internal Framework and Technology team, developing reusable HTML5/TypeScript UI components adopted across multiple internal projects.
mv.bullet4: Maintained PL/SQL (Oracle) objects and worked on fixes and rollout of a project with a Spring Boot backend and Vue.js frontend.
mv.bullet5: Traveled to Peru for requirements gathering and feature development on an ERP system with an international client.

accenture.bullet1: Developed features for Natura and Mapfre client systems using Java, Spring MVC, Spring WebFlow, Struts/Tiles, JSF and WebLogic.
accenture.bullet2: Worked on-site in São Paulo, embedded with client Natura, for business requirements gathering and feature development.

ufpe.bullet1: Developed screens and modules for the internal ERP system Sig@ using Java, JSF, Hibernate and Oracle.
